Description: report_schema_version is the Chainlink Data Streams report schema encoded by the feed ID (currently 3 for crypto and 8 for RWA).
market_status is meaningful for the v8 RWA schema: 0 unknown, 1 closed, and 2 open. It is zero for schemas without a market-status field.
last_update_timestamp is the v8 timestamp of the last valid price update, in nanoseconds. It is zero for schemas without this field and is not assumed to be monotonic across reports.
